verdicts.reason: A splits the hero apart: the can shrinks to a tiny thumbnail on the far left while the cream circle sits empty on the right, so it reads as a large blank blob. The subhead is jammed under the headline and the NEW VIDEO tag hangs loose. B places the white headline and subhead directly on the cream circle, so much of the text is close to unreadable, and the can floats without its circle. That is a severe collision.

A has the same white-text-on-cream-circle collision that makes the headline and subhead unreadable. On top of that, the SOLSTICE logo is moved to a tiny spot at the bottom and the badge overlaps the circle edge. B is legible, but the product composition is broken: a tiny can on the left, an empty circle on the right, a cramped headline and subhead, and an orphaned badge.

A keeps the original's structure well. The headline and subhead sit left-aligned on the dark background, and the can sits inside its circle with the NEW VIDEO tag on the right. Minor faults: the logo is small, and the can crowds the bottom of the circle. B is the broken split layout: the can is a thumbnail detached from its empty circle, the text block is cramped, and the badge floats.
